Container.Name: vLLM
Container.ReadMe: SM120-tuned, wake-on-request vLLM OpenAI-compatible server for an RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell. The model fully unloads after the configured idle timeout, releasing VRAM and model-owned RAM.
Container.Overview: On-demand vLLM 0.26.0 OpenAI-compatible API, configured for RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (SM120) and Qwen3.6-27B.
Container.Requires: Nvidia Driver plugin. RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell (SM120) recommended. The BF16 model requires the GPU to be mostly free.

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: GPU UUID or all

Config.Name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
Config.Description: Required NVIDIA driver capabilities

Config.Name: Model and compiler cache
Config.Description: Persistent Hugging Face weights and SM120 JIT caches

Config.Name: OpenAI API port
Config.Description: OpenAI-compatible API and Swagger UI

Config.Name: Model ID
Config.Description: Hugging Face repository or path under /models

Config.Name: Served model name
Config.Description: Short model name used by ComfyUI and OpenAI clients

Config.Name: Maximum context
Config.Description: Reduce this first if startup runs out of VRAM

Config.Name: GPU memory utilization
Config.Description: Fraction of total VRAM reserved by vLLM

Config.Name: Maximum concurrent sequences
Config.Description: Lower for interactive single-user use or VRAM pressure

Config.Name: Batched token budget
Config.Description: Prefill batching budget

Config.Name: On-demand model loading
Config.Description: Start vLLM on the first API request and fully unload it when idle

Config.Name: Idle unload timeout
Config.Description: Seconds after the final completed request before weights and KV cache are fully unloaded

Config.Name: Model load timeout
Config.Description: Maximum seconds the first API request waits for vLLM to load

Config.Name: Model stop timeout
Config.Description: Grace period before force-stopping vLLM during idle unload

Config.Name: Minimum free VRAM
Config.Description: Required free MiB before vLLM starts; prevents OOM while ComfyUI holds a large model

Config.Name: ComfyUI URL
Config.Description: When VRAM is low, release Comfy cached models only if its queue is completely idle; blank disables

Config.Name: Comfy release timeout
Config.Description: Maximum seconds to wait for idle ComfyUI to release cached VRAM

Config.Name: Private vLLM port
Config.Description: Loopback-only upstream port; do not publish it

Config.Name: Multimodal limits
Config.Description: JSON limits for image/video inputs

Config.Name: Default chat-template options
Config.Description: Preserve Qwen thinking across multi-turn agent conversations, as recommended in the linked working recipe

Config.Name: Prefix caching
Config.Description: Reuse common prompt prefixes

Config.Name: Tool calling
Config.Description: Enable Qwen automatic tool calls

Config.Name: Tool-call parser
Config.Description: qwen3_coder matches this model's XML tool format; use hermes only with a Hermes-format chat template

Config.Name: MTP speculative decoding
Config.Description: Experimental on SM120; benchmark after the baseline is stable

Config.Name: Text only
Config.Description: Set true to disable vision and free additional VRAM

Config.Name: KV cache dtype
Config.Description: Optional; leave blank for auto

Config.Name: Hugging Face token
Config.Description: Optional for this public model; required for gated/private models

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Optional bearer token; leave empty for LAN-only unauthenticated access
